name: review-cycle
description: Automated multi-agent code review cycle. Spawns reviewers in parallel (plus Codex when available), applies fixes per CLAUDE.md policy, admits a commit only when a reviewer saw exactly what it records, and asks before a push or pull request you did not request, unless you let it go further.

enabled.title: Commit gate
enabled.description: Refuse a commit unless a reviewer saw what it records, and stop at the step set in Stop before. Only you can change this, here in /config.

stopBefore.title: Stop before
stopBefore.description: The first step the agent asks you about unless you requested it: commit, push, open PR, merge, release, or never stop. Steps before it run without asking; a force push, a push to the default branch, a tag push and a remote delete always ask. A project's .claude/settings.json can only stop earlier; .claude/settings.local.json can set any step. Only you can change this, here in /config.
